entities.title: Cabinet forms a committee to assess loss and damage from the 23-24 Bhadra protests

properties.description: Item 3 of the cabinet meeting of Asoj 5, 2082 forms a five-member committee, convened by the secretary of the National Planning Commission, to assess loss and damage to public property, physical infrastructure and private institutions in the Bhadra 23 and 24 protests and to prepare a reconstruction plan. Item 2 of the same meeting allows public bodies to make urgent special-circumstance procurement to restore offices and services.

entities.title: Cabinet decides financial assistance for families of the identified dead

properties.description: Item 12 of the cabinet meeting of Asoj 9, 2082 provides each family of an identified Nepali citizen who died in the Bhadra 23 and 24 protests with Rs 10 lakh in financial assistance plus Rs 5 lakh for funeral, food and transport costs. Prisoners and juvenile-home inmates who died while escaping during the unrest are excluded in the text.

properties.description: One-page statement dated 9 September 2025, Kathmandu.
